mustFindings.requirement: Only forward transitions along the status chain
Cancel only while PENDING or PAID; SHIPPED/DELIVERED get 409
Full refund when a PAID order is cancelled

mustScenarios.risk: Cancelling a SHIPPED order must return 409, but CANCELLABLE includes SHIPPED so it succeeds
Cancelling a DELIVERED order is refused with 409
Cancelling a PAID order refunds the full captured amount; cancelling a PENDING order calls no refund
Skipping a step (PENDING straight to SHIPPED) or going backwards is rejected with IllegalStatusTransition
Each status change writes an order_status_history row with previous status, new status and actor id
The gateway refund fails while cancelling a PAID order: the order must not end up CANCELLED without a refund

forbidden.description: Partial refunds and store credit appear in neither the ticket nor the code

notes: AC2 is contradicted (OrderStatus.CANCELLABLE includes SHIPPED) and AC4 (status history table) has no code at all. Test, config and lockfile changes are noise.
